results.construction: Tap lattice points (3,5) and (5,3). Both lie within the board (x -1..6, y -1..6) and the set is graded order-free, so this is a correct answer.

hints.why: Fires if the student plots only (3,5), or only one of the two. The hint is correct, tells them to check both pairs, and gives no coordinates.

Fires if the student plots (3,5), (5,3) and also a stray point such as (1,1). The hint says only the two listed pairs should be plotted and explains the x-then-y move, so it is correct and gives no coordinates.

It cannot fire on this board. Reflecting the targets gives points like (-3,5) or (3,-5), and the board runs only from -1 to 6, so those points cannot be tapped. The hint also reveals that both numbers are positive, which is part of the answer.
